name: Meghmani Organics Ltd
about: Founded in 1986 as M/s Gujarat Industries, the company was incorporated in 1995 as Meghmani Organics Limited. The company manufactures Pigments and Agrochemicals through its 6 manufacturing facilities located in Gujarat. The company is amongst the top 3 Phthalocyanine based pigment players in the world and amongst the top 10 producers of pesticides in India.[1]Meghmani Organics Ltd (MOL) manufactures green and blue pigment products, which are used to manufacture printing ink, plastic, paints, textiles, leather, and rubber.It also manufactures a wide variety of commonly used pesticides for crop and non-crop applications, this include insect control in wood preservation and food grain storage.
keyPoints:
Business Segments
A) Agro Chemicals (70% in FY25 vs 76% in FY23): [1] [2] [3] The company manufactures products across the entire value chain, including technicals, intermediates, and formulations for insecticides and herbicides. Key intermediates include cypermethrin acid chloride, meta phenoxy benzaldehyde, and meta phenoxy benzyl alcohol. It has manufacturing facilities at Ankleshwar, Panoli, & Dahej in Gujarat. It generates over 80% revenue from export markets, including Africa, Brazil, Latin America, the US, and Europe. About 45% of the demand comes from the US and Brazil. It has a product registration base of 788 as of FY25 vs 693 in FY23.[4]  [5] The company reported revenue and EBITDA growth of 34% and 301% YoY, respectively, in FY25, driven by higher production and improved realization. [6]
